# jamfplatform_devices (Data Source)

List Jamf devices via the Device Inventory API. Requires **Device Inventory API** access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_devices" "all" {
}

data "jamfplatform_devices" "example_by_model" {
  filter = "model==\"MacBook Pro\""
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Optional filter expression to limit returned devices (e.g., `model=="MacBook Pro*"`).

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) Devices that matched the optional filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `id` (String) Internal identifier for this data source read.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `enrollment_type` (String) Enrollment type reported by the API.
- `id` (String) Device UUID (Jamf Pro Management ID).
- `last_check_in_time` (String) Timestamp of the last check-in in ISO 8601 format.
- `last_enrollment_time` (String) Timestamp of the last enrollment in ISO 8601 format.
- `last_inventory_update_time` (String) Timestamp of the last inventory update in ISO 8601 format.
- `model` (String) Marketing model string.
- `model_identifier` (String) Model identifier (e.g., Mac14,6).
- `name` (String) Device name reported by inventory.
- `operating_system_version` (String) Operating system version string.
- `serial_number` (String) Device serial number (case-sensitive).
- `user_id` (String) User ID associated with the device, if any.
